overview: The Spore Caverns are the corrupted core of Fungus Grove.
details: Toxic spores drift through the caverns, mutating fungal creatures. Corrupted pits spawn unstable beasts. The Corruption Engine pulses with alien energy, warping the entire region.
hooks: A corrupted pit begins spawning unstable spore beasts.
Toxic spore clouds drift toward nearby zones.
The Corruption Engine destabilizes, threatening a cavern collapse.
